culture-cycles.note: This is a one-off 2026 territorial special holiday for the visit of Pope Leo XIV, taken from the official national holidays dataset. That 2026 dataset does not list recurring provincial patron or foundation days, so this record does not claim a complete provincial holiday list. A nationwide holiday for the same visit on 9 November 2026 is a national day and belongs on Argentina's record, not as this province's own day. The official 2027 calendar (holidays-2027-es.json) was not yet published on 11 November 2026 (the file returned 404).
